correctness.rationale: Faces are compatible acyclic partial orientations of the 12 cube edges (one outgoing incidence per vertex), with 24 primitive vertices. Independently enumerating all 4^8 tail choices gives 23,625 augmented faces and vector (1,24,240,1296,4080,7488,7424,3072). A second independent exact computation reconstructed the 24-pivot toggle matching: 11,698 augmented pairs, 47 critical 5-faces and 182 critical 6-faces, and the signed integer 47-by-182 Morse attaching matrix (334 nonzero +/-1 entries). Exact unimodular elementary integer operations found 43 unit pivots and identically zero 4-by-139 remainder. Together with acyclicity of the full matched Hasse orientation and Hurewicz for the 5-skeleton wedge of 47 S^5, the surviving homotopy type is wedge^4 S^5 vee wedge^139 S^6. This is not inferred merely from mod-2 Betti numbers. Critical computation bounded to the finite cube; no assertion for higher hypercubes.
